slot_note: wave 3, Descriptive lane; architecture 2, a re-root at stage 1 of architecture 1 (Quenlow County Community College, completion as a cumulative incidence with competing endings), which was spent on its ask layer on 2026-11-01; new world, new dataset, new generator and new shell
niche: a state dust-diseases compensation fund setting the 2027-2031 horizon of its former asbestos workers' review program, the number of years after first exposure the annual reviews must run to cover nine in ten of the mesothelioma cases its pre-1986 workforce produces, from the fund's case register, which holds only the mesotheliomas diagnosed between the fund's start on 1 July 2004 and its 2025-26 close on 30 June 2026, with each case's first exposure taken from the claim's employment history
analyst_test: A strong analyst who derives each case's first exposure from the claim's employment history, keeps the workers first exposed before 1986, and admits each case to the risk set only from the fund's start on 1 July 2004 (the delayed-entry product-limit curve the survival field fits to a register that began after its cohort's exposure) reads nine in ten of the cases by 55 years and files a 55-year horizon; the register cannot show the long latencies of workers first exposed in the 1970s and 1980s, whose cases come after 30 June 2026, and the delayed-entry risk set reads their absence as their not happening.
domain_test: The deciding quantity is the latency distribution of mesothelioma from first asbestos exposure to diagnosis, a time-to-event distribution the survival analyst estimates, here from a case register that sees a case only if its diagnosis falls inside the register's years, so each case is observed under a window its own first exposure fixes on both sides and the estimate is the nonparametric maximum likelihood estimate for doubly truncated data; with a school's admissions in its place there is no induction period between an exposure and a disease for a register's opening and closing dates to cut, and the five-year review horizon has nothing to read.
layer1: the claims' employment histories in two layouts, the paper claim form keyed until 2012 and the online form from 2013, with workplace names in one and workplace codes in the other
first exposure read from the earliest spell the fund's assessment marks as exposed, across concurrent and overlapping spells
dates written several ways across the register's two systems
workers outside the pre-1986 cohort and non-occupational cases on the same register
stakeholder_role: the fund's health program manager, setting the review program's 2027-2031 horizon for the fund's board

driver: The decisive quantity is an upper cut of the delay from an origin to an event, estimated from a record that holds a case only if its event fell between the record's first and last dates, so each case's origin fixes both the shortest and the longest delay the record could have shown for it; correcting only for the record's start leaves the long delays of recent origins counted as absent, correcting only for its end overweights them, and the cut has to come from the estimate that conditions every case on its own two-sided window.
driver_concrete: The fund sets the former workers' review horizon at the shortest five-year step by which nine in ten of the pre-1986 workforce's mesotheliomas are diagnosed, but its register holds only diagnoses from 1 July 2004 to 30 June 2026, so a worker first exposed in 1950 can appear only at 54 to 76 years after exposure and one first exposed in 1980 only at 24 to 46; the delayed-entry Kaplan-Meier curve the register's start calls for still reads the missing long latencies of the 1970s and 1980s cohorts as absent and sets 55 years, while the nonparametric maximum likelihood estimate under double truncation puts nine in ten by 60.
stump: A competent solver reads each case's latency from first exposure to diagnosis, admits each case to the risk set only from the fund's start on 1 July 2004 (delayed entry) and files a 55-year horizon, because its product-limit curve passes nine in ten by 55; the step that lands it there is treating the register as seeing every latency after the fund began, when it also cannot see the latencies that end after 30 June 2026, which for workers first exposed in the 1970s and 1980s are their long ones, and the estimate that conditions each case on its two-sided window puts nine in ten by 60 years.

lineage.driver: The decisive quantity is the discount at which forced sales fall below the market value of the same units, where the record's own value for each unit is an error-prone proxy whose error grows with the unit's chance of being forced to sale; measuring the discount against that proxy counts the proxy's error as part of the discount.
lineage.note: seed DA16, a building society's forced-sale discount for one city: lending sits in Banking, whose task types serve no Descriptive objective; the exit-route mix is composition_mix and the open defaults maturity_censoring (both spent or banned now); measuring the discount against the same property's indexed last ordinary sale works only with the comparison filed, which makes the step rule application

lineage.fate: spent 2026-11-01 on its ask layer: with the honest careful-solver cracker both asks were executable (cracker 18 of 18 ask figures; two careful responses on the call reach 86.5), so the delivered cut stays on the portal as delivered and the slot re-roots into a new world, dataset, generator and shell
lineage.driver: The decisive quantity is the share of units whose spell ends one particular way within a fixed time of its start, estimated from a record in which many spells are still open and the others end in several ways; counting the spells that ended another way as if they were still open and could yet end the counted way spreads their chance over the counted ending, so the share has to be built from each ending's own hazard among the units still in their spell.
lineage.driver_concrete: The board reviews any program whose share of entering students earning the award within three years is below 30 per cent, but the fall 2024 and 2025 entrants are still enrolled, so the share must be estimated; a Kaplan-Meier curve of time to award that treats students who transferred out or withdrew as censored counts them as if they could still graduate and puts programs with heavy transfer above the floor, while the cumulative incidence of the award with transfer and withdrawal as competing endings puts them below it.
lineage.stump: A competent solver fits a Kaplan-Meier curve of the terms to the degree for each program's fall 2023 to 2025 entrants, censoring the admissions still open and also those that ended in a transfer out or a withdrawal, and sends only Early Childhood Education into review (22.2 per cent), the transfer-oriented programs at 34.8 to 41.4 per cent and Medical Assisting at 38.1; the step that lands it there is treating a transfer or a withdrawal as loss to follow-up, when it ends the admission's chance of the college's degree, so the share has to be the cumulative incidence of the degree with transfer and withdrawal as competing endings, which sends six programs into review.
lineage.answer: Six of the nine programs go into review in June 2027: General Studies, Biological Sciences, Business Administration, Psychology, Medical Assisting and Early Childhood Education.
lineage.world: Quenlow County Community College, Pennsylvania (program completion review, board of trustees)

differentiation.task271: task271 v2 reads the share of members holding a state from a latent-class model of who answers a call when; task266 estimates a time-from-exposure-to-diagnosis distribution from a case register that holds a case only if its diagnosis falls inside the register years, with no reachability, classes or calls
differentiation.task272: task272 v3 reads the share of a drifting process output outside a limit from sparse checks that stop runs; task266 conditions each case on its own two-sided calendar window to estimate a latency distribution, with no process, checks or resets
differentiation.task308: task308 v1 rebuilds requests a capacity-limited record never logged; task266 has no capacity limit (every case diagnosed inside the window is on the register), and the window two dates cut the latency each case could show
differentiation.task471: task471 v1 restores long trips by weighting replies that came back only if the trip ended before collection stopped, one right edge; task266 has both edges at once on a case register, the fund start hiding the short latencies of early cohorts and the 2026 close hiding the long latencies of late ones, and neither one-sided correction lands the horizon
differentiation.task265: task265 admits each legacy hip to a risk set at its registry enrolment (left truncation, one edge, a cohort registry that holds unrevised implants); task266 is a case-only register with both edges, where the delayed-entry curve task265 calls for is the wrong rung because it still reads the latencies that end after the 2026 close as absent
